notes: Ported from bubble-map Palantir deep-dive, defense/intel slice only (the civilian-agency Foundry fusion - IRS/SSA/CMS/NHS - belongs to the other map's digital-ID theme). Deepens the existing Palantir node into its actual programs.

entities.name: Palantir_Gotham
entities.notes: The intelligence/defense data-fusion platform. Won a competition vs the Army's DCGS-A; reported in use for battlefield/targeting data in Ukraine (operational specifics contested).

entities.name: Palantir_AIP
entities.notes: Artificial Intelligence Platform (2023+) wiring commercial LLMs onto Gotham/Foundry. AIP Bootcamps drove Palantir's US commercial surge.

entities.name: Maven_Smart_System
entities.notes: Palantir's AI targeting/data-fusion successor to Project Maven (DoD, 2017). May 2024 $480M Army prototype expanded to a ~$1.3B ceiling through 2029; fielded across services and combatant commands, and into NATO command.

entities.name: TITAN
entities.notes: Tactical Intelligence Targeting Access Node - Army ground station Palantir is prime on. Sensor-to-shooter data fusion, hardware+software at the tactical edge.

entities.name: US_Army
entities.notes: Primary US ground-force customer for Palantir (Gotham/Vantage/NGC2), Maven Smart System, and TITAN.

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.notes: Commercial LLM provider whose models integrate into Palantir AIP (via model partners) - the LLM layer bolted onto the defense-fusion stack.
